question: Who among the following wrote the book 'Breaking Rocks and Barrier'? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (23/06/2025) Shift 1)
options: Sudipta Sengupta
Pankaj Mishra
Arun Shourie
Soumitra Chatterjee
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sudipta Sengupta

Explanation:
The book 'Breaking Rocks and Barrier' is written by Indian geologist and mountaineer Sudipta Sengupta. She is the first Indian woman to conduct research in Antarctica and climb the Greenland ice cap. The book is based on her life and career challenges, inspiring women to break barriers in the fields of science and mountaineering.

question: Who is the author of ‘Rajatarangini’? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 1)
options: Jayadeva
Kalidasa
Kalhana
Chand Bardai
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kalhana

Explanation:
'Rajatarangini' is a significant historical work in Sanskrit literature, written by the 12th-century Kashmiri poet Kalhana. This book chronicles the history of the kings of Kashmir and is regarded as the first great historical work in Indian historiography. Kalhana composed it in an epic style, detailing the dynasties from mythical times to his own era. Other options: Jayadeva authored 'Gita Govinda', Kalidasa is renowned for plays like 'Abhijnanasakuntalam', and Chand Bardai wrote 'Prithviraj Raso'. Hence, the correct answer is Kalhana.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Author of Rajatarangini → Kalhana
☛ Language of Rajatarangini → Sanskrit
☛ Subject of Rajatarangini → History of Kashmir
☛ Period of Kalhana → 12th century CE
☛ First historical work → Rajatarangini is considered the first historical work in Indian historiography

question: Who is the author of the book 'Republic'? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/12/2020) Shift 1)
options: Leo Tolstoy
John Ruskin
Plato
TS Eliot
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Plato

Explanation:
The author of the book 'Republic' is Plato. It is a Socratic dialogue written by the ancient Greek philosopher Plato around 375 BCE, dealing with justice, the ideal state, and the philosopher-king. Plato was a student of Socrates and teacher of Aristotle. He founded the Academy in Athens, considered the first institution of higher learning in the Western world. 'Republic' remains a foundational text in philosophy and political theory. Leo Tolstoy is known for 'War and Peace', John Ruskin for 'Unto This Last', and T.S. Eliot for 'The Waste Land'.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Famous work of Plato → 'Republic'
☛ Teacher of Plato → Socrates
☛ Student of Plato → Aristotle
☛ Institution founded by Plato → Academy
☛ Ideal ruler in 'Republic' → Philosopher-king

Explanation:
'रिपब्लिक' पुस्तक के लेखक प्लेटो हैं। यह प्राचीन यूनानी दार्शनिक प्लेटो द्वारा रचित एक संवाद-शैली की कृति है, जिसमें न्याय, आदर्श राज्य, और दार्शनिक राजा जैसे विषयों पर चर्चा की गई है। प्लेटो सुकरात के शिष्य और अरस्तू के गुरु थे। उन्होंने एथेंस में अकादमी की स्थापना की, जो पश्चिमी जगत का पहला उच्च शिक्षण संस्थान माना जाता है। 'रिपब्लिक' को दर्शनशास्त्र और राजनीतिक सिद्धांत का एक मौलिक ग्रंथ माना जाता है। लियो टॉल्स्टॉय 'युद्ध और शांति', जॉन रस्किन 'आंटु दिस लास्ट', और टीएस एलियट 'द वेस्ट लैंड' के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं।

question: Which traveller and scholar wrote 'Kitab-ul-Hind'? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Al Biruni
Duarte Barbosa
Seydi Ali Reis
Ibn Battuta
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Al Biruni

Explanation:
'Kitab-ul-Hind' was written by the famous traveller and scholar Al Biruni. Al Biruni (973-1048 AD) was a Persian polymath, mathematician, astronomer, and traveller. He accompanied Mahmud Ghaznavi during his invasions of India and spent several years studying Indian culture. In this book, written in Arabic around 1030 AD, Al Biruni comprehensively described Indian religion, philosophy, science, mathematics, and social customs. His approach was objective and analytical, earning him the title 'Father of Indology'. He is also known for his works on astronomy, physics, and geography. 'Kitab-ul-Hind' remains a valuable primary source for understanding medieval Indian society from an external perspective.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Author of Kitab-ul-Hind → Al Biruni
☛ Al Biruni's full name → Abu Rayhan Muhammad
☛ Language of Kitab-ul-Hind → Arabic
☛ Al Biruni accompanied → Mahmud Ghaznavi
☛ Period of Kitab-ul-Hind → circa 1030 AD
question_hi: 'किताब-उल-हिन्द' किस यात्री और विद्वान ने लिखी? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)

सेदी अली रीस

'किताब-उल-हिन्द' अल बिरूनी द्वारा रचित एक प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ है। अल बिरूनी (973-1048 ई.) एक मध्यकालीन फारसी विद्वान, गणितज्ञ, खगोलशास्त्री और यात्री थे। वह महमूद गजनवी के दरबार में आए और भारत में लंबा समय बिताया। इस पुस्तक में उन्होंने भारतीय संस्कृति, धर्म, दर्शन, विज्ञान, गणित और सामाजिक जीवन का विस्तृत वर्णन किया है। यह ग्रंथ 1030 ई. में अरबी भाषा में लिखा गया था। अल बिरूनी को 'भारत का वैज्ञानिक अध्येता' भी कहा जाता है क्योंकि उन्होंने तटस्थ दृष्टिकोण से भारतीय ज्ञान परंपरा का अध्ययन किया।

question: Who composed the famous Tamil epic 'Manimekalai'?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/03/2021) Shift 1)
options: Nathakuthanaar
Tirotakkatevar
Sattanar
Ilango Adigal
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sattanar

Explanation:
'Manimekalai' is a famous Tamil epic composed by Sattanar (or Seethalai Sattanar). This epic is based on Buddhist principles and is considered one of the Panch Mahakavyams (five great epics) of Tamil literature. The protagonist, Manimekalai, becomes a Buddhist nun and spreads the message of dharma and compassion. The epic was written during the Chola dynasty and is regarded as a masterpiece of Tamil language. Sattanar presents Buddhist philosophy, the cycle of life, and karma in simple language.

'मणिमेखलई' प्रसिद्ध तमिल महाकाव्य है, जिसे सत्तनार (या सीत्थलाई सत्तनार) ने रचा। यह काव्य बौद्ध धर्म के सिद्धांतों पर आधारित है और इसे तमिल साहित्य की पंच महाकाव्य परंपरा में शामिल किया जाता है। 'मणिमेखलई' नामक नायिका एक बौद्ध भिक्षुणी बनती है, जो धर्म और करुणा का संदेश फैलाती है। यह महाकाव्य चोल राजवंश के काल में रचा गया था और इसे तमिल भाषा के उत्कृष्ट ग्रंथों में गिना जाता है। सत्तनार ने इस कृति में बौद्ध दर्शन, जीवन चक्र और कर्म के सिद्धांतों को सरल भाषा में प्रस्तुत किया है।

question: The book 'Systema Naturae' was written by Swedish botanist __________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (23/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: Carl Linnaeus
Goran Rothman
Anders Dahl
Carl Peter Thunberg
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Carl Linnaeus

Explanation:
'Systema Naturae' was written by Carl Linnaeus, regarded as the father of modern taxonomy. The first edition was published in 1735. In this work, Linnaeus classified nature into three kingdoms: mineral, plant, and animal. He developed the binomial nomenclature system, giving each species a two-word scientific name. He also classified humans as 'Homo sapiens'. His work revolutionized the field of biology and provided a systematic framework for naming and categorizing organisms.

question: Which of the following books is related to "Principles of Buddha" ? (RPF SI 2018 (16/01/2019) Shift 3)

Divya
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Abhidhamma Pitta

Explanation:
The book related to the Principles of Buddha is Abhidhamma Pitta. It is a part of the Tripataka, the collection of Buddhist scriptures. The Tripataka consists of three baskets: Vinaya Pitta (monastic rules), Sutta Pitta (Buddha's discourses), and Abhidhamma Pitta (philosophical principles). The Abhidhamma Pitta contains the Buddha's profound philosophical teachings and psychology. It explains core Buddhist principles such as the Four Noble Truths, the Eightfold Path, and the doctrines of karma and rebirth.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी पुस्तक "बुद्ध के सिद्धांतों" से संबंधित है? (RPF SI 2018 (16/01/2019) Shift 3)
options_hi: विनय पिटक
अभिधम्म पिटक
सुत्त पिटक
दिव्य
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है अभिधम्म पिटक

Explanation:
बुद्ध के सिद्धांतों से संबंधित पुस्तक अभिधम्म पिटक है। यह त्रिपिटक का एक भाग है, जो बौद्ध धर्म के ग्रंथों का संग्रह है। त्रिपिटक में तीन पिटक होते हैं: विनय पिटक (भिक्षुओं के नियम), सुत्त पिटक (बुद्ध के उपदेश), और अभिधम्म पिटक (दार्शनिक सिद्धांत)। अभिधम्म पिटक में बुद्ध के गहन दार्शनिक सिद्धांतों और मनोविज्ञान का विवरण है। यह बौद्ध धर्म के मूलभूत सिद्धांतों जैसे चार आर्य सत्य, अष्टांगिक मार्ग, और कर्म-पुनर्जन्म के सिद्धांतों की व्याख्या करता है।

question: Who is the author of the book Padmavati? (RPF SI 2018 (12/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Aamir Khusro
Jiauddin Barani
Malik Muhammad Jayasi
Siraj Afif
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Malik Muhammad Jayasi

Explanation:
Padmavati is a Sufi romantic epic written by Malik Muhammad Jayasi in 1540 CE. It is composed in Awadhi language and narrates the love story of Princess Padmavati of Sinhala and King Ratansen of Chittor. The work also describes the invasion of Chittor by Alauddin Khilji. Jayasi was a Sufi poet, and Padmavati is considered a masterpiece of Sufi poetry. Among the other options, Aamir Khusro was a famous poet but not the author of Padmavati; Jiauddin Barani wrote 'Tarikh-i-Firozshahi'; and Siraj Afif wrote 'Tarikh-i-Mubarakshahi'.

☛ Which Sultan is mentioned in Padmavati? → Alauddin Khilji
☛ With which poetic tradition is Malik Muhammad Jayasi associated? → Sufi romantic poetry
question_hi: पद्मावती पुस्तक के लेखक कौन हैं? (RPF SI 2018 (12/01/2019) Shift 3)
options_hi: आमिर खुसरो
जियाउद्दीन बरनी

सिराज अफ़ीफ़
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है मलिक मुहम्मद जायसी

Explanation:
पद्मावती एक सूफी प्रेम काव्य है जिसे मलिक मुहम्मद जायसी ने 1540 ई. में लिखा था। यह अवधी भाषा में रचित है और इसमें सिंघल की राजकुमारी पद्मावती और चित्तौड़ के राजा रतनसेन की प्रेम कथा का वर्णन है। अलाउद्दीन खिलजी द्वारा चित्तौड़ पर आक्रमण की घटना भी इसमें शामिल है। जायसी एक सूफी कवि थे और इस कृति को सूफी प्रेम काव्य की श्रेणी में रखा जाता है। अन्य विकल्पों में आमिर खुसरो एक प्रसिद्ध कवि थे लेकिन पद्मावती के लेखक नहीं, जियाउद्दीन बरनी 'तारीख-ए-फिरोजशाही' के लेखक हैं, और सिराज अफीफ 'तारीख-ए-मुबारकशाही' के लेखक हैं।

question: The book "Book-ul-Hind" is written by whom? (RPF SI 2018 (12/01/2019) Shift 3)

Marco Polo
Ibn Battuta

question: With which of the following fields is Munshi Premchand associated? (RRB JE CBT I (30/05/2019) Shift 1)
options: Dance
Music
Painting
Literature
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Literature

Explanation:
Munshi Premchand is one of the most famous writers in Hindi and Urdu literature. He was born on July 31, 1880 in Varanasi. His major works include 'Godaan', 'Gaban', 'Nirmala', 'Karmabhoomi' and 'Sevasadan'. He is known for his realistic writing style, through which he highlighted poverty, social injustice and the problems of rural life. Premchand is also honoured with the title of 'Upanyas Samrat' (Emperor of Novels). He enriched Hindi literature by writing stories and novels. His writing is both simple and deep, which continues to influence readers today.

question: Who authored the book 'Hind Swaraj', which outlined the principles of non-violent resistance and self-rule? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (05/06/2025) Shift 3)
options: Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Jawaharlal Nehru
Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Mahatma Gandhi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mahatma Gandhi

Explanation:
Mahatma Gandhi authored the book 'Hind Swaraj' in 1909, which outlined the principles of non-violent resistance and self-rule. This book became the foundation of Gandhi's philosophy, criticizing modern civilization and presenting the concept of Indian self-rule (Swaraj). 'Hind Swaraj' is regarded as a seminal text in the Indian independence movement.
